name: revision
title: Revision
description: Words added and words struck, inside the sentence they change.
use: A suggested edit, a tracked change or a correction shown in running text. The ins and del elements carry the meaning; the classes give them a wash, an underline and a strike that carry across line breaks.

instead.when: The words are emphasized, not changed

classes.name: ins
classes.description: Inserted words, on an ins element: a wash of the success hue over a fine underline

classes.name: del
classes.description: Deleted words, on a del element: half their ink, on a wash of the danger hue under a strike

example: The release is planned for Thursday Tuesday.
